maintain the recommended level of moisture in the base material for the recommended duration

make pile and give turnings as per schedule
pasteurise the mushroom compost to kill the harmful micro-organisms
arrange for protection of mushroom compost from pathogens or pests
use the relevant PPE and clothing

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate method of spawning such as spot spawning, surface spawning and layer spawning
create holes of the recommended depth maintaining appropriate space in case of spot spawning
plant lumps of spawn in the holes
apply a cover of compost on the holes after planting spawns
spread spawn evenly on the top layer of the compost in case of surface spawning
mix spawn in the compost at the recommended depth
apply a thin layer of compost on spawn mixture

pasteurise the compost and casing soil with formalin solution
apply a cover of polythene on the compost after making it wet
remove the polythene cover after the recommended duration
carry out compost turning to remove the smell of formalin
apply casing mixture when the mushroom mycelium spreads completely
apply water in the recommended quantity using a sprinkler
maintain the recommended temperature, Potential of Hydrogen (pH) and relative humidity
arrange for protection of growing mushroom from dry air

plug water leakages to prevent the wastage of water
